# Ignite 2026: What's new in Microsoft Sentinel
## **Co-author: Vivek Kokkengada**
* **The foundation for agentic security:** Integrated Security Operations (ISOC) is now available to eligible Microsoft Sentinel customers with Defender Suite, Microsoft 365 E5 and Microsoft 365 E7 licenses. ISOC brings SIEM and threat protection together in Defender to simplify operations and get more value from existing Microsoft security investments **.**

...

## **Unified security operations for agentic security**
### Integrated Security Operations Center (ISOC) expands to Microsoft Sentinel customers
Starting November 17, 2026, existing Microsoft Sentinel customers with Microsoft 365 E5, Microsoft 365 E7, or Microsoft Defender Suite licenses can opt in to [ISOC in Microsoft Defender](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/defender-xdr/isoc-overview) , bringing SIEM and threat protection together.

...

* **90 days of retention** up from 30 days for eligible Defender data.
* **Lower-cost ingestion** at $2.4 per GB to broaden visibility across Microsoft and non-Microsoft data through 500+ connectors.
* **Integrated SIEM and threat protection** within Microsoft Defender giving teams a shared view, richer context, and more connected workflows across security operations.

...

### More visibility into automation
Investigate unexpected changes to your security automation with a record of who changed what and when. Now in public preview, audit logs in the Microsoft Defender portal lets you track the creation, editing, activation, deactivation, and deletion of automation rules and generated playbooks. Search, review, and export these records to trace configuration changes to support compliance and governance.

...

## **More data for richer context**
### Expand security visibility for stronger protection
New and expanded coverage include Microsoft Edge for Business, Microsoft Copilot for government cloud, [Microsoft Purview Information Protection](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/sentinel/connect-microsoft-purview) , [Dragon Copilot](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/industry/healthcare/dragon-admin-center/monitor/monitor-sentinel) , CrowdStrike API & RTEM, Wiz Push, Salesforce Audit Logs, OpenAI Audit Logs, and more.

...

### Analyze security data together with ingest-time data normalization
Bring security logs from different sources into standardized schemas so your team can more easily analyze them together. Coming to public preview in December 2026, Microsoft Sentinel ingest-time normalization uses Microsoft-managed parsers to standardize selected data as it is ingested.

...

## **Simplified connections**
### Build Microsoft Sentinel connectors faster with AI in VS code
The [Microsoft Sentinel Connector Builder Agent in VS Code](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/sentinel/isv/create-custom-connector-builder-agent) will be generally available by the end of November, making it easier for developers and partners to build, validate, and deploy connectors with less manual effort.

...

### Monitor connector health and data ingestion
Now in public preview, the new Data & Connectors Overview tab in the Microsoft Defender portal provides a unified view of connector health, ingestion volumes, and trends across Analytics and Data Lake tiers.

...

* [Manage all your Microsoft Sentinel data in one place with Unified Data Management (Public Preview)](https://techcommunity.microsoft.com/blog/microsoftsentinelblog/manage-all-your-microsoft-sentinel-data-in-one-place-with-unified-data-managemen/4565940)
* [Configure Azure Monitor pipeline](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/azure-monitor/data-collection/pipeline-configure)
* [**Plan your move to the Microsoft Defender portal**](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/sentinel/move-to-defender) **:** Access the latest Sentinel innovations and streamline security operations by transitioning ahead of the March 31, 2027, Azure portal support deadline. Get started with our [video series.](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Hgcz87XdJx0&list=PL3ZTgFEc7Lyska6WLWBzc8sob-kYA2jPj)

...
